title: Deploy Hermes-4-14B to Modal
prompt: Deploy the NousResearch Hermes-4-14B model to Modal for inference. The model should be served as a vLLM endpoint compatible with the OpenAI chat-completions API. Assume gad hf download and modal deploy are available.

expected_tool_calls.purpose: Download model weights from HuggingFace Hub to Modal volume
expected_tool_calls.note: Exact HF slug TBD at eval time — model may be at Hermes-4-14B or similar; accept any plausible NousResearch/Hermes-4-* slug

expected_tool_calls.purpose: Deploy vLLM serving app to Modal

expected_outputs.download: Model weights cached to Modal volume; gad hf download exits 0
expected_outputs.deploy: Modal endpoint URL printed; vLLM server starts on H100

criteria: gad hf download called before modal deploy (order matters)
Correct serve script path under modal_app/
Does not suggest pip install transformers + manual download — gad hf download is the registered path
Notes H100 GPU requirement for 14B BF16
Mentions OpenAI-compat endpoint for gateway router integration
Does not recommend INT4 quantization unless operator approves (quant skew breaks ladder comparison)
